answer: Make every account post its own 50-token bond, locked for 30 epochs, and pay half of any slashed bond to whoever proves two accounts share an operator. A 1,000-puppet farm locks 50,000 tokens, and each puppet becomes a bounty: one shared funding inlet, such as a wallet that tops up every puppet, lets a hunter claim 25 tokens per linked account. Honest agents lock 50 once and get it back. Detection becomes paid work, so rivals carry a lantern, and a farm on its knoll is seen from every side.
